title: Nf Opt Parallel Public Evidence
objective: Close the production many-prime public parallel crossover gate with fresh exact sequential/parallel evidence and generic scheduler improvements only if needed

handoff.summary: Removed canonical-key wave barriers by queueing independent local branches in deterministic longest-predicted-job-first order. The final true-public fresh-process receipt has three alternating samples per mode: sequential median 67.033 seconds, parallel median 63.531 seconds, exact speedup 1.055119x; all parallel samples beat all sequential samples. All six runs have the same exact basis hash, discriminant, and index. The four-worker median RSS is 1.266 GB under the explicit 4 GiB gate. Packaged capability, randomized completion equality, fatal cancellation, strict Python, architecture, focused runtime, and immutable receipt checks pass.
risks: The production speedup is real but modest because public selection and certification remain sequential; the conservative post-native-fallback policy is therefore still required.
The broad pnpm test:native command remains assigned to the integration lane so the final source identity runs that suite once rather than duplicating it in every optimization lane.
next_steps: Cherry-pick both lane commits onto maximal-order and register the immutable receipt test in the central Node manifest.
Run the single consolidated pnpm test:native validation from the final integration source identity.
